main_text.p: Mensa erat, e lignis Sittim longitudine sua duorum cubitorum, latitudine vnius, altitudine vnius & dimidiati, auro obducta, vt iugiter haberet praesentem faciem Dei.ibid.
Partes brace Circumiens. brace ver.24.25. erant Infernæ.
Circumiens, erat limbus aureus circumquaq;. ver.24.
Limbus aureus erat ad faciem circumquaq; ne vacillaret mensa. Ibid.
Annuli erant quatuor aurei, quatuor angulis inditi, qui in quatuor pedibus eius erat: e regione fasciæ proximè sub ea erant, ut esset sedes vectibus ad portandam ipsam arcam. ver.27.
Vectes erant e lignis Shittim auro obducti ut portaretur mensa. ver.28.
Vasa erant ex auro, quibus sternebatur mensa ver.29.

page.notes: Left margin notes are cut off and only fragments are visible: "ongi-", "auro", "uaq;", "o.1.2.", "iuxta", "late-". Printed text in the margin is incomplete and not transcribed. The Greek/Latin brace layout is approximated. Words marked "Sittim" and "Mensa" read as printed. Some words in the first paragraph may be imprecise due to scan quality. Left margin holds cut text from the preceding page (fragments such as "vectiu", "ante", "cum", "expia-", "teflate", "vt pro", "in se", "cti, vt", "retur", "c. 8 3", "us erat", "Erant"); not transcribed as the page proper. The bottom-right smudge reads roughly "Coronem" and is illegible. Brace-and-label layout was rendered as outline lines; the braces' exact grouping is approximate.
